[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

**1. Sameer ke DM wale “dost” kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person frame ka kya kaam?**

Transcript ke ground par:
- DM mein Sameer likhta hai: *“ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon… woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.”*
- Group chat (pehle) mein Tushar Sameer ko *“bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab”* aur *“gym king”* bolkar uske khud ke business/setup ka zehrata hai; Sameer khud *“expanding soon boys”* likhta hai.
- DM mein Sameer ne specifically kaha: *“group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai.”* Matlab woh “dost” group mein apne career moves public nahi karna chahta — jo Sameer khud hai, jo group mein sirf “business boom” dikhawa kar raha hai.

**Kaun hai:** “Dost” aur koi nahi, khud Sameer hai. Usne apne liye 15-18 LPA ki operations/general management job talash rakhi hai, par group mein apne aap ko “sponsor” aur “expanding” wala bana rakha hai.

**Third-person frame ka kaam:**  
Yeh costume isliye hai taaki:
(i) Apni job talash ko apni hi “businessman” image se alag dikhaye (ego safe rahe).  
(ii) Faisal se favour maang sake bina directly “main job dhoondh raha hoon” kehne ke — taaki woh “gym king” wale persona par se pani na phir jaye.  
(iii) Privacy ka bahana dekar group mein exposure rok le.

---

**2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya? DM chup kyun ho gaya?**

Trace:
- *College group, agle din 1:30 pm:* Faisal likhta hai *“reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂”* — yeh direct reference hai DM wale “private rakhta hai” waiver ko todta hai; Faisal ne Sameer ke DM ke tone ko group mein taunt/mazak banakar phenk diya.
- Sameer ka reply sirf *“👍”* hai — matlab usne notice liya ki Faisal ne uski privacy ki boundary halki kar di, par kuch nahi bola.
- *Teen din baad ke DM:* Faisal *“HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?”* aur *“hello? bhai?”* likh raha hai — lekin Sameer ka koi jawab nahi.

**DM chup kyun ho gaya:**  
Thumbs-up (👍) ne group mein Faisal ke joke ko passively accept kiya, par sath hi trust toot gaya kyunki Faisal ne “private” wali baat ko “business boom” joke se expose kar diya. Teen din ki silence isliye kyunki Sameer ko ab Faisal par bharosa nahi raha ki woh discreetly help karega; usne CV bhejna band kar diya taaki apna “dost” cover na phate.

---

**3. Woh DM jo Faisal ko ab bhejni chahiye (bina admit kiye ki tum hi woh dost ho):**

```
Bhai Sameer, HR ne aaj phir poocha ki wo bande ka CV kab aayega — unko operations wale profile pe jaldi bandi karni hai. Tu jab free ho bas draft bhej de, main aage badha dunga. Koi group wali baat idhar nahi uThegi, pakka discreet rahega. Batana bas.
```

(Yeh DM bina ye kehne ki “tu khud hai woh”, sirf help ka channel khula rakhti hai aur pehle ki privacy promise ko quietly reinforce karti hai.)
